headline: Markets closed today for Diwali-Balipratipada; Sensex, Nifty ended last session at multi-month highs

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 11 November.

why: Indian stock markets (NSE and BSE) are closed today on account of Diwali-Balipratipada.
Trading on domestic stock exchanges will resume on Wednesday, 11 November.
MCX remains closed for the morning session but is scheduled to reopen for trading in the evening.
Benchmark indices ended the previous session at their highest levels in over eight months.
whatHappening: Hind Rectifiers reported a 54% decline in Q2 net profit.
MRF reported a 28% slip in Q2 net profit.
India VIX jumped 68% over three weeks despite benchmark rally.
Sensex and Nifty 50 have risen over 6% across the last five trading sessions.
summary: Indian stock markets are closed today for Diwali-Balipratipada, with regular trading set to resume on Wednesday, 11 November. On the last trading day, Sensex and Nifty extended gains to close at multi-month highs following a 6% rally over five sessions. On the corporate front, Q2 earnings saw Hind Rectifiers and MRF report profit declines.
